explanation: Standard CLAS12 eta settings were used (model 3, full O(alpha), 6.53 GeV beam, recoil proton, vcut=0.166 GeV^2). EXCLURAD wrote delta as NaN because its bremsstrahlung integration returned NaN (the tai integration output contains NaN); therefore delta is null. The independently evaluated unpolarized Born cross section was written as 0.865E-03 (represented numerically here as 0.000865).
